description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of Guard Tower.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures. This way it is also good enough for close-ups.
Model is built with great attention to details and realistic proportions with correct geometry.  
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 711 Triangles

  - 369 Polygons

  - 503 Vertices

  - Model is one mesh.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot point centered at world origin.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Wooden Farmhouse
Realistic, quality and low polygonal 3D model of Old Farmhouse. Model is ready to use in games and other real time applications. Farmhouse is built with great attention to details and realistic proportions with correct geometry. Wooden Barn Building is detailed perfectly and optimized for all platforms and ready to use in games and other projects. The mesh topology is clean, efficient and has only tree and quad polygons. The model is fully textured with all materials applied. All colors can be easily modified. No special plugin needed to open scene.Everything shown in the screenshots.
Features 

  - High quality low polygonal model, ready for games and renders. 

  - All colors can be easily modified. 

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene. 

  - No cleaning up necessary—just drop your models into the scene and start rendering. 

  - No special plugin needed to open scene. 

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

Formats 

  - 3ds Max 2009 

  - OBJ (Multi Format) 

  - 3DS (Multi Format) 

  - Blender 3D 

  - DAE 

  - FBX

Also check other Architectural and Industrial 3D models click to username ( NarkR ) to see complete gallery. Good luck !

description_text:
Traffic signs pack 3D Model. 8 individual objects sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
8 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 26236 vertices, 26132 quad faces (52264 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Description:  Lamp based on Japanese design made in teak wood
Model: Modeled in Maya 2018. Lowpoly model with 2162 tris available for games, also available the highpoly model.Hipoly model, used for baking purposes, can be found inside the .ma file Real world scale (1 unit = 1cm), 1 level of detail, unfolded and unwrapped UVs.Two Uv Maps embedded, second  Uv Map is for lightmap.
Textures: PBR textures painted with substance Painter:

  - Unreal 4 (Metalness) packed RMA 4k TGA 8Bit { 3 maps: Base Color - Normal Map - Emissive Map - RMA } Tested in Engine, results like the marmorset preview

  - Unity 5 packed 4k TGA 8Bit {3 maps: Albedo - Normal Map - Metallic Smoothness } Not tested in engine.

  - Standard PBR Metalness 4k Tga 8 Bit { 6 maps: Albedo - Height Map - Ambient Occlusion - Metallic - Normal Map - Emissive Map - Roughness Map} 

The different Textures are separated in they respective RAR file
How to use RMA texture file:RMA stands for: Roughness, Metallic, Ambient Occlusion; Simply Connect: Red Channel to Roughness, Green Channel to Metallic and Blue Channel to Ambient OcclusionWhen Imported inside Unreal, remember to remove the sRGB tick, because Roughness, Metallic and Ambient Occlusion are linear maps and should be threated as such.
Why RMA: Packed files reduces memory space used.

High-quality low-poly 3D model of Cleaning Cart.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
This way it is also good enough for close-ups. The model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with correct geometry. 
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 3324 Triangles

  - 1924 Polygons

  - 1869 Vertices

  - Model is correctly divided into parts to suit the animation process.

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real-world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - Blender files and example render scenes (Eevee studio setup and Cycles HDRI)

  - Blender files in 2 versions (packed and regular-unpacked)

  - Unity3D 2018.4 (.unitypackage)

  - Unreal Engine 4.27 (.uasset)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - 3ds Max 2018 (.max)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Additional Info:

  - Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information about this 3d model.
I will try to write back as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
Model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with correct geometry.
Textures are very detailed so it makes this model good enough for close-ups. 
Technical details:

  - 2048 Diffuse and AO texture set

  - 1045 Triangles

  - 571 Polygons

  - 803 Vertices

  - Model is one mesh.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot point centered at world origin.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

description_text:
The majority of what you're paying for when you buy this product is not a mesh, but an ultra-high-resolution texture created with a photo-scan comprised of 98 photographs.  The resulting texture is 63 megapixels (14,000 pixels by 4,500 pixels), and it is UV mapped onto a 28 foot by 9 foot plane.  The texture resolution is 500 pixels per foot, or 250,000 pixels per square foot, giving enough detail for close shots.  It has also been edited to be seamless in one direction, allowing the road to be repeated over a distance.
The scene in Blender is set up with an example curve, the appropriate modifiers, and a material for micro-displacement.  For intermediate/advanced users, everything should be self-explanatory.  If you're new to Blender, or something seems hard to understand, please don't hesitate to message.
The download includes:

  - A single 63 megapixel texture for albedo and displacement

  - A plane object in a Blender file with all the necessary modifiers and material settings to make a seamless road.

  - An example curve to show how the arrayed mesh can follow a pre-determined path.

  - An OBJ version of the plane with UV unwrapping for use/modification in the 3D software of your choice.

description_text:
These two simple sidewalk materials were photoscanned and processed to have a high level of texture detail.  Texture sets include both Albedo and Normal maps.  Sidewalk 1 has an optional plant density map.  The Blender file is set up so that the sidewalks are extremely low-poly, and the simple-subsurf modifiers allow the customer to control the level of detail in the sidewalk meshes. The sidewalks are tileable and can be arrayed along a curve if the user so desires. The Simple Grass particles are included with the Blender file.
This package, 2-Pack A, is older, published in 2017 and revised in 2022.  You may find Sidewalk 2-Pack B to be more detailed and interesting.  The new sidewalks for 2-Pack B also have 16-bit height maps for accurate, high-quality displacement.
You can find 2-Pack B here: https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/scanned/various/tileable-photorealistic-sidewalks-2-pack-b-16-bit-height

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 68
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 46
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Small 4 door sedan
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V6
Sport pack:Yes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)

Seats:Comfort Seats

description_text:
This volume is a group of different roadblocks that you see all around the city. The models are recreated with precision in Blender. You could use these as props for your game or your short movie...
-Model :
The models alone without any modifiers applied are pretty low-poly. They look exactly like the real roadblocks you see every now and then on the road. If you like to do close-ups I suggest to crank up the subdivision level to 3.
-Material : 
I used the principled shader for every model in this vol. Metallic to Dielectric.
-Texture :
I applied a street ground texture on the floor with the roughness and the normal maps.
I applied a sign texture on the yellow sign.

description_text: Between the forward and reverse gears of an outboard gearbox sits a clutch that is attached to the shift shaft, with the prop shaft being attached to the clutch. When the shift shaft is in neutral, the clutch isn't engaged with either the forward or reverse gears, so it remains motionless, as does the prop shaft. When the shift shaft is put into its forward position, it engages the clutch with the forward gear, which causes the clutch (and the prop shaft) to rotate in one direction. When the shift shaft is put into its reverse position, it engages the clutch with the reverse gear, which causes the clutch (and the prop shaft) to rotate in the opposite direction.

description_text:
A crankshaft is a shaft driven by a crank mechanism, consisting of a series of cranks and crankpins to which the connecting rods of an engine are attached.[1] It is a mechanical part able to perform a conversion between reciprocating motion and rotational motion. In a reciprocating engine, it translates reciprocating motion of the piston into rotational motion, whereas in a reciprocating compressor, it converts the rotational motion into reciprocating motion. In order to do the conversion between two motions, the crankshaft has crank throws or crankpins[clarification needed], additional bearing surfaces whose axis is offset from that of the crank, to which the big ends of the connecting rods from each cylinder attach.

description_text:
Cleaning the outboard engine after each ride is the single most important factor of longevity for every outboard engine. Salty water that circulates in the engine block for cooling during normal operation may be the root cause for a wide variety of issues. 
When the outboard is removed from the water, the salt inside the walls gets dried and forms a layer of hardened material that reduces heat discipation.
In order to clean the salt from inside the engine, you can use an outboard engine washer that helps feed fresh water on the water inlet in the lower unit and cleans the whole engine.

Car Name: SHC MCE 66
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 53

description_text:
Pumpkins, Jack-o-lanterns, and Gourds.

Modeled and rendered (Mental Ray) in 3ds Max 7 without plugins or post production.

Modeled primarily with quad based topology so you can easily chose the models resolution with a subdivision modifier. 

The model and textures are all named and organized. And the Jack-o-lanterns lids are separate objects so you can remove them if desired. 

The textures included are in both PSD Photoshop and JPG format - 1042x1042 resolution and include a color, bump, and a specular map.

.Max7 file format notes:
The objects are organized into layers and the render lighting setup is included!

.3ds file format notes:
Quads are intact, just apply subdivision as desired.
The texture coordinates are the same as the max version so all you have to do is apply the material. simple instructions are included in case you need them.

.Obj file format notes:
Quads are intact, just apply subdivision as desired.

description_text: This is one of two houses on this property.  It is in an area of Christiansted called Free Gut. Free Gut was an area in Christiansted and Frederiksted where Free Colored Persons lived.  Prior to 1848 Free Colored Persons were not permitted to build houses in the town center, but were restricted to a free-black neighborhood communities in the hills of Christiansted and Frederiksted.   The area is still known as Free Gut. ------  La Vaughn Belle is an artist on St. Croix. She has taken on an interesting film project that will tell the story of Free Gut. This house, she refers to it as “The House the Freedom Built", will be the subject of the story. The story follows the artist along her journey in restoring the building, researching its previous owners and learning about the larger, very special community to which they belonged. ------ Hopefully, I will be able to update this model and share the progress of her creative endeavor and more of the story.

Thank You for your prospective purchase.

description_text:
40 Wall St. is a 927ft (283m) tall skyscraper in New York City. The building, originally called the Manhattan Company Building, was constructed on the same plot in Lower Manhattan that its namesake company had operated upon since 1799. 40 Wall St was designed by architect H. Craig Severance with assistance and consulting from Yasuo Matsui and Shreve & Lamb in a style that fuses Art Deco and Gothic architectural motifs.Famously, this building competed, in an official skyscraper race, with the Chrysler Building, only to lose out in the end when architectures secretly constructed a larger spire to out-soar its Wall St rival. Enhancing the skyscraper's notoriety, Donald Trump purchased the building and began renovations in the 1995. While taller buildings have gone up across the city, 40 Wall St remains one of the tallest, most recognizable buildings on the New York skyline.
Because 40 Wall St shares walls on the lower floors with other buildings on the block (30 Wall St, the short beige building and 44 Wall St, the medium height brick building), the model of 40 Wall St by itself would have several blank faces that would normally be covered. Because many people might find this to spoil the appearance of the builiding, the 2 adjecent buildings mentioned are included in the model. It is possible to print all 3 buildings separately or all in the same mesh.Because this building is particularly tall and may exceed the maximum print volume of most consumer 3D printers, the building may be printed in 2 halves (glued together roughly halfway up the building at the setback where the main tower portions begins to rise) or all in one piece.
The STL files included and their descriptions are as follows:

  - 
40WallCompleteBase.STL - The bottom half of 40 Wall St + 30 and 44 Wall St attached

  - 
40WallStandaloneBase.STL - The bottom half of only 40 Wall St

  - 
40WallTower.STL - The tower portion of the building. This model is to be glued onto either of the 2 models listed above

  - 
40WallCompleteFull.STL - The full height of 40 Wall St + 30 and 44 Wall St attached. The entire model in one piece. 

  - 
40WallStandaloneFull.STL - The full height of only 40 Wall St

(Note: This model was originally uploaded in 2019, but has been redone from scratch in November of 2021 to improve accuracy and detail.)

Thank You for your prospective purchase.

description_text:
Alfa Romeo Spider (1966)El Alfa Romeo Spider es un roadster producido por el fabricante de automóviles italiano Alfa Romeo desde el año 1966 hasta 1993. Ampliamente considerado como un diseño clásico, que se mantuvo en producción durante casi tres décadas con pequeñas modificaciones estéticas y mecánicas. Las tres primeras series fueron hechas por Pininfarina en Grugliasco y la cuarta serie en San Giorgio Canavese.
Al término de su fabricación, Alfa Romeo continuó usando la denominación Spider para describir a las versiones descapotables del Alfa Romeo GTV (1995-2006) y luego del Alfa Romeo Brera 2006.

Car Name: SHC MCE 61
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 58
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 53
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Extended Wheelbase 4 door sedan
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V8
Sport pack:Yes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)
Front bumper:Tier 5
Rear bumper:Tier 4
Dashboard:Tier 2
Exhaust:Tier 2
Wheels:Tier 2
Glass Roof:No
Seats:Comfort Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:Yes
Trim Color:Glossy black
Interior Leather Color:White
Tinted Rear Windows:Yes
Wheel Color:Alloy

Model of a Three Floors Building.
Originally created with 3ds Max 2009. 
This model is suitable for use in design visualization, architecture visualization. 

- 300 separate objects organized in groups
- All the groups (floors) are properly named for easy handling.
- 1 Camera and 1 Sky Light.
- 12580 polygons, 18172 vertices.
- This model includes mental ray materials.
- All preview images are rendered with Mental Ray Renderer

Folding, charging, using, transporting, storing the ELECTRICMOOD is so easy! Strength

Automotive AC Electric MotorDESCRIPTION
3D model of a electric motor with great torque and power, designed for automotive use. It works with alternating current and with a high voltage. It is an induction motor (brushless) with permanent magnets. It is quite similar to the classic electric motors used in sedan and racing vehicles. Also, it has measurements and proportions quite similar to that of a real electric motor of this category. It has cooling by water and oil.
USE

Digital 3D model of reception bell.
MODEL

  -  Model dimensions: LWH 14,8 x 14,8 x 11,0 cm (5.8 x 5.8 x 4.3 in).

  - Objects count - 1 polygonal object, no groups.

  - Model is not subdividable.

  - Model is made mostly of quads and some triangles. No n-gons were used.

  - Polycount:

  - Polys - 4 400

  - Tris - 8 576

  - Verts - 4 325

MATERIALS

  - Materials are prepared for Corona and Marmoset Toolbag renderers.

  - Materials are PBR compliant

  - Scanline, FBX and OBJ formats has only basic materials and will NOT render the same as in preview images.

TEXTURES

  - Format - PNG

  - Count - 5

  - Map types - Base colour, Roughness, Normal, Metallic, AO

  - Bit depth - 8 bits

  - Resolution - 4096 x 4096 px

  - Textures are collected into one archive and are delivered in separate file.

SCENE

  - Model is scaled to accurate real world dimensions.

  - Objects, materials and textures has meaningful and matching names.

  - Transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ].

  - All texture paths are set to relative.

FILE FORMATS

  - 3ds Max - Corona

  - 3ds Max - Scanline

  - FBX

  - OBJ

  - TBSCENE (Marmoset Toolbag 4)

  - GLTF

  - GLB

  - USDZ

GENERAL

  - Modeled in 3ds max.

  - Preview images are rendered with Marmoset Toolbag.

  - Images are straight from rendering app. No post processing were applied.

  - Render scenes are not included.
